messages:
tala: uploaded prototype for recurring suppression (quiet hours) inside the SLO notification editor. big questions: how to surface recurrence rules in a compact preview and what AT should announce when a recurring rule is active.

igor: love the idea. compact preview idea: show a single line like 'Quiet hours: weekdays 22:00-07:00' with a chevron to expand details. keeps the edit row small.

maya: UX trade: some teams want human-friendly labels like 'Nightly quiet' vs full rrule text. propose primary label friendly, secondary accessible detail with full rule.

jin: accessibility: screen readers need the timezone and recurrence context. aria text should be something like 'Quiet hours active: weekdays, 10pm to 7am Pacific, recurs weekly'. avoid raw rrule strings.

a11y-bot: Recommendation: expose a single summary region with aria-live=polite on toggle. Provide aria-describedby that references a hidden verbose text element containing timezone-aware wording. Example: 'Quiet hours: weekdays 22:00 to 07:00 PST, recurring'.

igor: when a recurrence starts/ends automatically, do we announce each transition? ops teams worried about chattiness. suggest a setting per-org: announce transitions (off/brief/detailed). default brief: announce only summary changes.
tala: good point. i'll add an 'announce verbosity' dropdown to the recurrence modal. default brief per a11y-bot rec.
maya: preview UI: show upcoming window instances (next 3 occurrences) in a small list under the summary. helpful for confirm before saving. ensure this list is keyboard navigable and read by screen readers when expanded.
jin: microcopy: replace 'suppress' with 'Pause notifications' across recurrence flows. tooltip/aria can say 'Pause (suppress notifications)'. keeps friendly language.
a11y-bot: Checklist: 1) summary label + hidden verbose description (aria-describedby); 2) timezone included in aria text; 3) polite live for state changes; 4) announce-verbosity setting default brief; 5) upcoming instances exposed as list role=list with aria-label.

tala: decisions: compact summary row + expand for details, human-first label + hidden verbose aria text, upcoming 3 instances visible on expand, announce-verbosity control in modal, use 'Pause notifications' microcopy. i'll update the Figma and add a small prototype for the aria strings. ETA tomorrow AM.

igor: thanks! tagging eng for sync after frames so they can confirm timing and analytics hooks. :raised_hands:
